title: TruckScenes full mini raw coverage and publisher object support
sensor_configuration: RADAR_LEFT_FRONT, LIDAR_LEFT and LIDAR_TOP_FRONT separately; publisher per-box counts additionally aggregate radar sensors
annotation_schema: All original released 3D-box classes for object support; stock detection mapping for separate raw box-centre plot
split: All 400 mini samples across 10 scenes; characterisation includes training scenes, no detector scoring

environment.hardware: Local CPU; no new GPU/model inference

measurements.name: box observations
measurements.scope: All released annotations; 1094 instance tokens, repeated over 400 samples

measurements.name: radar-supported observations
measurements.scope: Publisher num_radar_pts > 0; denominator 25750 LiDAR-supported released box observations

measurements.name: radar returns at 150-400 m
measurements.scope: RADAR_LEFT_FRONT, shared ego forward +/-30 degrees, denominator 147829 returns over 400 samples

measurements.name: corner LiDAR points at 150-400 m
measurements.scope: LIDAR_LEFT, same 400 samples and sector, denominator 9708528 points

notes: Fusion is the controlled vocabulary for multi-modality characterisation, not point-cloud or detector fusion. Raw data reread locally; publisher object counts not independently recounted. Every released box has LiDAR support, so neither count is detector recall. Calibration/timing/annotation-population limitations are recorded in the report. Agent-run evidence, not human signoff.
